title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
skills: Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.
description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Technical Account Managers work cross-functionally to support Stripe’s largest and most complex users. Through trusted relationships we offer customized, strategic consultations and proactively identify opportunity areas to help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize technical operations on their teams, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you’ll do

Strategically support Stripe’s largest and most complex users.

Responsibilities


Provide a gold standard experience to your assigned accounts’ key stakeholders
Work with the wider Operations team to provide current state, resources and knowledge to enable gold standard experience across teams interacting directly with the user via support channels, external documentation, or product/feature feedback or development
Foster long term user relationships that grow loyalty to Stripe and Stripe products
Work cross-functionally both internally and within your user’s organizations to provide and implement operational solutions on subjects not limited to fraud/disputes, declines, product adoption and global expansion
Work closely with Account Management and other user facing teams as part of a larger effort to support users on Stripe
Lead user facing meetings both in person and through video chat
Collaborate on the continued design of this support offering
Create user-facing content for long term solutions



Who you are

We are looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


5+ years experience in enterprise level client-facing work
Strong product sense and energized by the challenge of solving difficult user related problems
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to lead complex integration conversations in a highly consultative and proactive manner
Familiarity with APIs and ability to explain API concepts to Stripe’s largest and most technical customers
Familiarity with SQL and comfort building basic queries and modifying more complex ones
Strong technical troubleshooting skills and experience interfacing with technical teams
Adept client relationship management skills
Ability to engage in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization
Bachelor's Degree required



Preferred Qualifications


Operations savvy mindset, with an ability to identify and eliminate process friction while continuing to build scalable processes
Experience practicing in small to medium scale project management
Strong organizational skills and self-starting mindset
Experience with tools like Postman, xCode, Python, Webhooks, and ETL
Experience in the payments industry



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Descripción Empresa

El Puerto de Liverpool es la empresa líder en tiendas departamentales en México. Con más de 170 años en el mercado, nos dedicamos a facilitar la selección de productos y brindarles el mejor servicio a las familias mexicanas, esperando superar las expectativas de calidad, moda, valor y atención dentro de un ambiente agradable.

Contamos con cinco unidades de negocio: Tiendas Liverpool, Tiendas Suburbia, Centros Comerciales Galerías, Boutiques y Negocios Financieros, componiendo una empresa sólida, que ofrece a sus colaboradores estabilidad financiera y el orgullo de pertenecer a una empresa 100% Mexicana.

Nuestra misión es servir al cliente en todo lugar, todos los días, toda la vida, nuestra visión es ser la mejor opción en servicio, surtido y valor. Nuestros valores nos guían hacia el trabajo en equipo, productividad, innovación e integridad.

Coordinar la estrategia de MKP, campañas, entregas y desarrollo de equipo para maximizar la experiencia del cliente y metas del negocio

- Diseñar y coordinar la estrategia comercial junto con Sellers y 1P para impulsar las ventas y el crecimiento de la dirección de MKP.

description:
About the job

Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

 

 

 

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across Mexico, team members located within 80 kilometers of our Guadalajara office (Calle Amado Nervo 2200, Jardínes del Sol, 45050 Zapopan, Jal.) are expected to work onsite to support collaboration, speed, and execution.

Drive Customer Growth. Deliver Better Outcomes.

As an Inside Sales Representative (Customer Expansion), you’ll drive revenue growth within Nextiva’s existing small business customer base. This is a high-velocity sales role where you’ll proactively reach out to customers, uncover opportunities, and deliver solutions by connecting customer challenges to the value of Nextiva's AI-Powered Platform. You’ll support US-based customers, with customer interactions and day-to-day work conducted in English.

You don’t need a traditional sales background to succeed here. We’re looking for people who have demonstrated success against revenue-related targets, whether in sales, account management, retention, collections, or another commercially focused customer role—and are ready to build their career in technology sales.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Drive Expansion Revenue: Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within Nextiva's existing small business customer base. 
Create Opportunities: Proactively engage customers through outbound calls, email, SMS, and other channels rather than waiting for leads. 
Understand the Customer's Business: Engage small business customers across a variety of industries, ask effective questions, uncover business challenges, and connect their needs to the right Nextiva solutions. 
Position Nextiva's AI-Powered Solutions: Clearly articulate the value of Nextiva’s platform, including AI-driven capabilities that improve customer experience and business outcomes
Demonstrate Value: Deliver focused product demos and clearly explain how Nextiva’s solutions can help customers achieve better business outcomes. 
Move Quickly: Manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up to keep a high-velocity sales cycle moving. 
Own Your Pipeline: Manage opportunities from outreach through close while maintaining accurate pipeline, activity, and forecasting information in Salesforce. 
Continuously Improve: Apply coaching, performance insights, and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve your customer conversations, productivity, results, and product knowledge. 
What Success Looks Like

You’re motivated by growth—both in the results you deliver and the career you’re building. You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and bring energy and resilience to a fast-paced sales environment. You’re coachable, curious, and willing to keep learning.

Successful team members:

Consistently meet or exceed expansion revenue targets
Are comfortable creating opportunities through proactive outbound outreach
Represent Nextiva professionally in customer conversations, including video meetings. 
Build rapport quickly, and confidently move customer conversations toward an outcome
Stay organized while managing multiple customer conversations and opportunities at once
Bring consistency and discipline to follow-up, keeping opportunities moving
Respond well to coaching and quickly put feedback into practice
Stay resilient, learn from setbacks, and maintain momentum in a performance-driven environment
Effectively incorporate AI tools into your workflows to improve speed, quality, customer experience, and outcomes. 

Experience matters, but mindset and execution matter more. This role is a strong fit for someone building or transitioning into a career in technology sales, where effort, consistency, and a growth mindset translate directly into success.

What You'll Bring
2+ years' experience in a customer-facing role where you were directly accountable for revenue-related goals or targets, in a fast-paced environment
A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding those goals
Advanced English fluency, both spoken and written, with the ability to simplify complex and/or technical concepts
Comfort with frequent outbound customer conversations and proactive outreach
The ability to thrive in a high-velocity environment with short, fast sales cycles
A professional, customer-ready presence and communication style. You’ll regularly interact directly with customers by phone, email, and video
Business curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different customers, industries, and business needs
Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail
Coachable, with demonstrated ability to apply feedback to improve performance
Self-motivated and resourceful, you take ownership of your work and take initiative to solve problems
Demonstrated curiosity about AI and technology; motivated to continuously learn, apply new tools, and build your sales and product knowledge

Relevant experience can come from many backgrounds. Examples include roles with sales quotas, upsell or cross-sell goals, customer retention/save targets tied to revenue, collections or recovery targets, account growth, or other commercially focused performance goals.

Nice to Have:

Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
Exposure to SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecommunications, or other technology products
Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM
Experience supporting US-based customers in a B2B environment
Exposure to AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) in a professional setting

Compensation & Growth

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
Opportunity to grow and advance your career with a company at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. 
Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work. 
Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. 

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

Growth 🌱- Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

 

 

 

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.

About the job

Job Title: UI Developer




Job Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




Job Summary:

We are seeking an expert UI Developer to join our customer's team and play a critical role in delivering seamless, responsive, and visually appealing user interfaces. You will collaborate with designers and engineers to transform design specifications into high-quality, accessible, and performant web experiences. If you are passionate about crafting pixel-perfect interfaces and have a keen eye for UX best practices, we invite you to bring your expertise to our dynamic environment.




Key Responsibilities:

• Build, optimize, and maintain intricate UIs using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks.

• Translate Figma designs and wireframes into pixel-perfect, reusable components with Tailwind CSS, SCSS, and Bootstrap.

• Ensure consistent and responsive design across devices and browsers through best-in-class coding standards.

• Implement performance optimizations and uphold web accessibility (WCAG) best practices throughout the stack.

• Integrate frontend components with REST APIs, ensuring smooth data flow and robust user interaction.

• Collaborate with designers, developers, and stakeholders using strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Own the frontend architecture, advocate for clean code, and actively participate in code reviews.




Required Skills and Qualifications:

• 4+ years of hands-on experience in professional UI development with a primary focus on React and TypeScript.

• Advanced proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

• Experience with responsive design methodologies and cross-browser compatibility.

• Strong expertise in DOM manipulation, REST API integration, and frontend performance tuning.

• Mastery of version control using Git and collaborative workflows.

• Proven ability to convert design specifications from Figma into flawless, maintainable code.

• Deep understanding of web accessibility standards and UX principles.




Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience architecting scalable frontend solutions in large codebases.

• Familiarity with automated testing frameworks for frontend applications.

• Prior contributions to open-source UI component libraries or design systems.




We are looking for a dedicated professional who is driven by quality, thrives on solving complex problems, and is committed to delivering exceptional user experiences. Join our customer's team and make a tangible impact through your frontend expertise.

About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

description:
About the job

Bnberry is transforming the $87 billion travel tech industry by changing how hotels and resorts connect with guests worldwide. We're building DBS — a new kind of product that hotels adopt as a B2B SaaS business tool, and that travelers experience directly as a consumer-facing hotel booking journey.

This is not a Product Owner or delivery-management role focused on writing tickets and managing developers. Your mandate is to own DBS end-to-end, connecting three product areas that most companies keep separate: the guest-facing booking experience, the hotel-facing workflows and business value, and how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools.

What You'll Own


 The consumer-facing booking journey — including the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and how PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations shape what the guest sees
 Hotel-facing workflows tied to DBS: onboarding, reporting, and adoption
 The product capabilities that help hotels improve and measure visibility across search engines and AI discovery tools, in partnership with Marketing and relevant specialists
 Booking-funnel performance and conversion
 The link between guest experience and measurable hotel business value


What You'll Do


 Define product vision and roadmap for DBS, connecting guest booking UX, hotel workflows, and AI discovery into one coherent product
 Own the booking journey end-to-end — identify friction in calendars, date selection, room/rate selection, checkout, and confirmation, and understand how availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations affect what the guest experiences; work with Engineering on dependencies and failure cases
 Translate hotel onboarding, reporting, and adoption needs into product decisions that show measurable business value to hotel customers
 Own the product capabilities behind search and AI/GEO visibility — partner with Marketing and relevant specialists on execution, while building enough SEO/GEO literacy to identify and prioritize the right product bets
 Interview hoteliers and travelers and run usability tests; translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear priorities
 Define success metrics before building, and use experiment results to guide iteration
 Work closely with Design and Engineering through detailed user journeys, making trade-offs and shipping in small, practical iterations
 Align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around DBS priorities, and take responsibility for product outcomes


Requirements


 3+ years of product management experience owning customer-facing products, including relevant experience in hospitality technology or travel booking
 Relevant, demonstrable connection to the US market
 Hands-on customer research skills — hotelier and traveler interviews, usability testing, and translating findings into clear priorities
 Strong analytical and experimentation skills — diagnosing booking-funnel friction, testing improvements, and measuring booking conversion, hotel adoption, and retention
 Comfortable working through detailed user journeys with Design and Engineering, making trade-offs, and shipping in small iterations
 Able to operate independently with ambiguity, prioritize by customer and business value, and align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success


What We're Looking For:

Industry-Grounded — You've worked in hotel technology, B2B hospitality platforms, or a B2C travel product with an actual booking journey. Deep exposure to hotel distribution systems is a plus, not a prerequisite — strong B2C travel/booking experience counts too.

US Market Fluent — You have demonstrable familiarity with US hotels or travel customers, whether through working with them directly or through living and studying in the US combined with hospitality experience.

Booking UX Owner — You understand the details of a booking flow — calendars, date selection, room and rate choice, checkout, confirmation — and the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations. You can spot friction before a customer complains about it.

Fluent in Both Guest and Hotel — You're as comfortable reasoning about a traveler's booking journey as you are about a hotelier's onboarding, adoption, and ROI.

Fast Learner on AI/SEO — You understand how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools, and can pick up emerging SEO/GEO capabilities quickly enough to know which product bets are worth making — without needing to personally execute SEO.

Success Metrics

Examples include: booking conversion rate, hotel adoption of DBS, feature adoption, booking-funnel completion, search and AI/GEO visibility for hotels on DBS, customer and hotelier satisfaction, and retention.

Important Clarification

This role is not a traditional Product Owner responsible primarily for backlog management and task assignment. The focus is on owning DBS as a genuinely new product category — one that has to work as a business tool for hotels and as a booking experience travelers actually use.

Benefits


 Competitive salary plus equity package
 Define a new product category — DBS sits at the intersection of B2B SaaS, consumer booking, and AI discovery, largely undefined by competitors today
 Autonomy to experiment, take risks, and drive discovery
 Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and a massive traditional industry

title: Customer Support Specialist
skills: Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.
Revisar las órdenes de compra de los clientes y verificar que se encuentren alineadas con las cotizaciones, precios y condiciones comerciales acordadas.
Coordinar con Service Engineers, Field Service, Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, Procurement y Finance para asegurar el cumplimiento eficiente de las órdenes.
Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes sobre el estado de sus órdenes, programación de servicios, fechas de entrega y actualizaciones relevantes.
Monitorear el avance de las órdenes, identificar posibles retrasos y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en el cliente.
Asegurar que las solicitudes de los clientes sean atendidas de manera oportuna y profesional, de acuerdo con los niveles de servicio establecidos.
Apoyar las actividades de facturación, asegurando que la documentación de servicio esté completa, correcta y disponible dentro de los plazos requeridos.
Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.
Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio
description:
About the job

Cada día tenemos oportunidades de generar un impacto positivo en nuestros colegas, socios, clientes y en la sociedad. Juntos, desarrollamos las soluciones del futuro y liberamos todo el potencial de los recursos esenciales.

Confiamos en que las personas actúen con iniciativa y desafíen las formas tradicionales de pensar para desarrollar tecnologías líderes a nivel mundial, capaces de impulsar el progreso en áreas fundamentales como la energía, los alimentos, el agua y la industria marina.

Es una excelente oportunidad para una persona que disfrute trabajar en un entorno dinámico, administrar múltiples prioridades y contribuir directamente a la satisfacción del cliente y a los resultados del negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades


Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.

Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.


Requisitos


Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio


Nos preocupamos por la diversidad, la inclusión y la equidad en nuestros procesos de selección. También creemos que las características conductuales pueden entregar información relevante sobre el ajuste de una persona a un determinado rol.

Para ayudarnos en este proceso, utilizamos las evaluaciones de Pymetrics. Al momento de postular, recibirás una invitación para completar los juegos de evaluación.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation and diversity

The Principle CX Prog Mgt Professional, Customer Experience Transformation – M&A Integration & S/4 Readiness leads strategic Customer Experience transformation initiatives that enable business growth, operational scale, and enterprise modernization.

This role is initially focused on leading Customer Experience integration activities for acquired PT businesses, ensuring successful transition of Customer Service and Order-to-Cash processes into Honeywell operating models and systems. As Honeywell's Helix / S/4HANA transformation progresses, the role expands to lead CX change management, business readiness, and adoption activities across CX Shared Services globally and, over time, additional SBGs.

The role partners with business, functional, and technology teams to drive process standardization, organizational readiness, stakeholder alignment, and successful adoption of new operating models, tools, and ways of working while maintaining a strong customer focus.

Reports to: Sr. Director, CX Transformation

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

M&A Integration Leadership


Lead Customer Experience integration workstreams for acquired businesses, including Customer Service and Order-to-Cash processes.
Partner with business and functional leaders to align people, process, data, and systems requirements during integration activities.
Develop and execute integration plans, track milestones, manage risks, and ensure operational readiness for successful transition into Honeywell.
Identify and drive standardization, efficiency, and synergy opportunities across acquired organizations.
Provide executive-level reporting and communication on integration progress, risks, and outcomes.


S/4HANA Change Management & Readiness


Lead CX change management and business readiness activities supporting Helix / S/4HANA deployments.
Prepare CX teams for migration from legacy environments, including CIP300 and BRP900, to future-state S/4 processes and operating models.
Conduct stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, readiness reviews, and risk mitigation activities.
Partner with S/4 program teams, process owners, training teams, and business leaders to ensure successful deployment and adoption.
Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization efforts.
Establish and leverage change champion and SME networks to drive adoption across regions and business groups.


Transformation & Operational Excellence


Drive process harmonization, standardization, and adoption of best practices across CX Shared Services.
Support Voice of Customer (VOC) and Closed Loop initiatives by translating customer insights into transformation opportunities.
Partner with CX Operations, Operational Excellence, Training, Digitization, and OTC Transformation teams to ensure sustainable implementation of change.
Support implementation of digital, automation, AI, and process improvement initiatives that increase productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and customer-centric decision making.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
Significant experience in Customer Experience, Customer Service, Order-to-Cash, business transformation, ERP deployment, acquisition integration, or related leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional transformation programs in a global environment.
Strong understanding of Customer Service, Order-to-Cash, and customer-facing business processes.
Experience managing complex stakeholder groups, executive communications, risks, and program governance.


Preferred Qualifications


MBA or Master's degree preferred.
Experience with SAP, S/4HANA, ERP deployments, or large-scale business system transformations.
Experience with acquisition integration and operating model transitions.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required; Black Belt preferred.
Experience with Prosci, ADKAR, or other structured change management methodologies.
Strong communication, facilitation, and leadership skills.
Ability to lead through influence within a complex matrix organization.
Global business services or shared services experience preferred.


Success Measures


Successful integration of acquired businesses into Honeywell CX operating models.
Achievement of integration milestones, readiness targets, and value realization objectives.
Effective deployment and adoption of Helix / S/4HANA across impacted CX organizations.
Strong stakeholder engagement and organizational readiness across deployment waves.
Improved process standardization, scalability, data quality, and operational effectiveness.
Sustainable adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working.
Positive impact on customer experience, employee experience, productivity, and business performance.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

skills: Cómo trabajarás: la IA es el sistema operativo, no una herramienta
Ya eres nativo de la IA. Si estás leyendo esto y no usas Claude, ChatGPT o Cursor varias horas cada día laboral, cierra la pestaña.
SQL es tu capa de auditoría, no tu oficio. Lo lees, lo validas, no lo escribes línea por línea.
Construyes análisis de cohortes, informes de experimentos, diagnósticos por país y memorandos ejecutivos con IA. Entregas en horas lo que un analista tradicional entrega en días.
Construyes agentes reutilizables para todo lo que se repite: revisiones comerciales semanales, detección de anomalías, escaneos de cohortes de cancelación, exploraciones profundas de países.
Detectas cuando la IA está equivocada: números alucinados, uniones fabricadas, lógica confiada pero errónea. Esta es la habilidad más importante en el puesto.
Si tienes un GitHub, un Notion o un cuaderno lleno de flujos de trabajo personales con IA, envíalo con tu solicitud.
Cómo se ve el éxito
30 días: Conoces el modelo de datos de Pro a la perfección. Tu pila de IA está construida. Has entregado tu primer informe que cambió una decisión.
90 días: Posees completamente una parte del P&L de Pro. Los GM de CRM, Producto y País te consideran el DRI para tu número, no solo soporte analítico.
6 meses: Has movido tu número. Has construido al menos un flujo de trabajo de IA que el resto del equipo de Pro ha adoptado. El Jefe de Pro confía en tu juicio sin necesidad de re-verificar.
12 meses: Estás operando al nivel de alguien con más de 5 años de experiencia.
No aplicar si

¿Te animas a construir el futuro de Latinoamérica? 🚀

Aquí hacemos que las cosas pasen. Si te mueve resolver problemas de escala real, aprender en tiempo récord y ver el impacto de tus ideas en cuestión de días, este es tu lugar.

Rappi Pro, Analista (Report Directo Head de Pro). Remoto, LatAm

El reto

Rappi Pro es uno de los principales impulsores del volumen de Rappi y el programa más directamente vinculado a nuestro beneficio bruto a largo plazo. Pequeños movimientos en nuestros Resultados Clave principales se traducen en un impacto material en P&G en toda la empresa. Ese es el tipo de negocio que estamos entregando a un analista con experiencia de 0 a 4 años.

Estamos contratando a personas en etapas tempranas de su carrera con intención. Queremos alguien sin cicatrices, sin el "así se hacía en mi antigua empresa" y con fluidez nativa en IA. Reportarás directamente al Head of Pro. Sin intermediarios, sin capa de traducción, sin política de grupos de analistas.

Este no es un rol de soporte. Serás responsable de una parte del negocio Pro y serás evaluado por resultados, no por entregables.

Lo que administrarás

Serás responsable personalmente de una o más partes del P&G de Pro: un Resultado Clave (por ejemplo, mejoras de plan), un corte por país o una línea estratégica de trabajo. Tu trabajo no es "apoyar el análisis". Tu trabajo es manejar tu parte como un mini-GM:

Conoces tus números al detalle. Si el COO pregunta a las 9 p.m., respondes en menos de 30 segundos.

Diagnosticas qué está funcionando y qué no. Presentas propuestas, no problemas.

Impulsas la ejecución transversal -CRM, Producto, Country GMs, Finanzas- para mover tu número. Ninguno de ellos nos reporta. Aun así, haces que suceda.

Escribes los memorandos, preparas las revisiones y eres responsable de las presentaciones cuando toca tu parte.

Ejecutar y optimizar procesos de Growth Specialist en Rappi, aplicando expertise técnico y generando insights que impulsen decisiones de negocio.

SQL es tu capa de auditoría, no tu oficio. Lo lees, lo validas, no lo escribes línea por línea.

Construyes agentes reutilizables para todo lo que se repite: revisiones comerciales semanales, detección de anomalías, escaneos de cohortes de cancelación, exploraciones profundas de países.
Detectas cuando la IA está equivocada: números alucinados, uniones fabricadas, lógica confiada pero errónea. Esta es la habilidad más importante en el puesto.

PayJoy customers. You’ll combine customer behavior, analytics, experimentation, and UX insights to identify opportunities and create digital experiences that are more relevant, intuitive, and high-converting.

title: Growth Client Specialist
skills: Own a defined book of active US customer accounts and know each one cold: their org, their hiring plans, who loves working with us, and where the headroom is.
Build and run a quarterly account plan for every priority account: where the growth will come from, who we need to meet, and what happens next. Your book, your strategy.

Run a relationship motion with our champions: regular, value-led check-ins; one specific intro ask at a time; every touch carrying something useful - never a "just checking in." The goal is trusted-advisor status, and you'll know you have it when retention stays high and your pipeline of new opportunities never dries up.

Map and multithread your accounts - buying centers, org charts, the next buyer - and keep that map live in HubSpot so the whole company sees what you see. Get introduced or go direct, and open the door.
Book and run expansion calls with US executives, and bring our founders in on the biggest opportunities.
Catch new needs the moment they appear: a job posting, a growing team, a placement change that needs a backfill.
Sell across everything Near offers: staffing, direct recruiting, engineering, finance, and AI talent.
Run your own operation: build your lists, run your sequences, keep your pipeline clean, forecast your numbers. You'll have modern tools (Clay, AI) and the autonomy to use them.
Help shape the playbook as you run it: this function is new, and what works for you becomes how Near does expansion.
Protect the base you're growing: spot delivery risk early and get it to our recruiting team fast.
Based in Latin America, with strong US time zone overlap.

Apply today and let's build something extraordinary together!

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

You own Product & Lifecycle Growth marketing for Everand and Fable, end to end. Everand is our audiobook and ebook subscription product; Fable is our book-tracking and discovery community. Both are built for people who love books and reading. You'll set the positioning, plan the launches, build and ship the campaigns yourself, and measure what they move.

This is a senior individual contributor role built for a self-starter who is energized by both the strategy and the build. You'll go from a launch narrative one day to building the campaign in Iterable the next, and you'll go hands-on whenever that's the fastest path to impact.

What You'll Do

description:
About the job

Why join us? 

Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of HermanMiller means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows HermanMiller to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.

Proceso de ventas en córner de PH para Herman Miller.

¿Como cerrar una venta?


- Conoce tu producto. 


El primer paso es conocer a la perfección la propuesta de valor, lo que vamos a proporcionar al cliente y lo que ofrecemos en el mercado.

El conocimiento del producto y la marca en general determinará la eficacia del argumentario de venta, lo que llevará al cliente a creerse o no las ventajas que ofrece.


- Prospección de clientes. 


En este punto nos ayudamos de todas las herramientas mercadológicas y publicitarias que tiene ya dispuestas Herman Miller en México y el mundo, así como El Palacio de Hierro, para generar ese flujo de gente tanto en las tiendas como en nuestros corners, sin embargo, depende de nosotros mantenerlos en optimas condiciones visuales para atraer a esos clientes que ya están en la tienda. El display es muy importante para que eso suceda, todos los días al llegar a nuestro corner debemos revisar todo aquello que pudiera estar dejando de ser atractivo para nuestros clientes. De igual forma nuestra imagen personal debe ir acorde con lo que tanto Herman Miller como el Palacio de Hierro quieren proyectar a sus clientas ya que somos la imagen de los mismos antes esos clientes.


- El primer contacto. 


El primer contacto es muy importante para que el cliente adquiera una buena impresión de la marca, lo que debemos vender son dos cosas básicas:


La idea de la marca y no solo el Producto. 
A nosotros mismos como profesionales expertos y eficientes. Debemos transmitir que creemos en los valores de la marca y el producto que ofertamos. 


Siempre que un cliente se acerque al corner de Herman Miller el promotor debe recibirlo con un saludo que indique al cliente que esta siendo bienvenido al corner y que se le va a atender como se merece, el cliente con ello percibirá la disponibilidad de nuestra parte para asesorarlo en su proceso de selección.


- Establecer las necesidades. 


Debemos conocer las necesidades de tus Clientes, pero haciendo que sean ellos mismos quienes nos las digan. Tenemos que conocer sus inquietudes. Interesarnos por ellos de verdad y descubrir que es lo que realmente quieren comprar.


- Presentar el producto acorde a sus necesidades. 


En este punto es donde ponemos en practica lo aprendido en el punto uno, ya que sin primero conocer bien nuestra marca y nuestro producto y sin entender cuál es la principal propuesta de valor que tenemos, en este punto no vamos a conseguir una respuesta positiva de nuestro cliente.

Cualquier presentación debe seguir etapas planificadas, guiando al Cliente paso a paso hasta que llegue a entender lo que nuestro producto puede hacer por él.

La presentación del producto conforma la imagen mental que tiene el cliente potencial de nosotros y el producto. Debemos emplear lenguaje en positivo y ser convincentes.


- Cerrar la venta. 


A nuestros Clientes les tiene que resultar fácil decir SI gestionando correctamente sus objeciones. Ayúdales a tomar la decisión que antes has tomado por ellos. Nuestra misión principal en este terreno es conseguir ventas.

Una vez cerrada la venta…

En Herman Miller utilizamos diversos formatos de apoyo para realizar una venta, todos ellos deben estar en tu bandeja de entrada de tu correo electrónico, ya sea para descargarlos y usarlos en el día a día, o algunos que se alimentan únicamente abriendo el link en el correo electrónico para, una vez abierto, ingresar los datos solicitados.


- Formato de ventas y Formato de facturación y entrega de producto (Carta Porte). 


Estos dos formatos deberás descargarlos a tu computadora y tenerlos a la mano ya que los necesitaras siempre que cierres una venta, ambos de llenan con los datos de tu cliente, así como con los datos del articulo que vendiste y también datos del cobro que encontraras en el ticket de PH.

Una vez recabados los datos en ambos formatos, deberás solicitarle a tu cliente que te firme los dos formatos. Por lo que puedes recabar los datos en tu computadora, después imprimirlos y pedir que los revisen y los firmen, o bien imprimirlos y llenarlos a mano y después recabar la firma.

Con estos formatos pedirás a uno de los vendedores de El Palacio de Hierro, que te ayuden con el cobro del producto, y después de que el cobro quede listo le debes pedir al vendedor de PH una copia del ticket de venta.

Tu te quedaras con los formatos firmados y con la copia de el ticket, el cliente únicamente se llevará su ticket de PH original. Deberás escanear estos formatos junto con el ticket de PH ya que posteriormente los vas a necesitar en otra plataforma. Te sugiero que los guardes en una carpeta con el nombre de tu cliente ya que en ella agregaras también otros documentos.


- Formato de stock de Excel. 


En tu correo electrónico buscaras el formato de stock el cual deberás abrir en la liga.

Una vez abierto, en la parte inferior izquierda, te colocaras en la pestaña “ventas” e ingresaras toda la información que te solicitan los campos. Esto registrara la venta en dicho formato, descontando del stock la pieza que vendiste para de esta forma llevar un control del mismo.


- Formato de Pipeline. 


También en tu correo buscaras dicho formato, abres en la liga, y se desplegara otro formato en Excel. En el mismo, una vez que corrobores que te encuentras en la pestaña de data, ingresaras todos los datos que te solicita, algunos van a tener que quedar en blanco ya que son datos que tendrás hasta después, estos los completaras días después que se genere dicha información. (Proyecto, Acknow).


- Formato de reconocimientos. 


De igual forma que los dos anteriores, deberás abrir la liga que desplegara otro formato de Excel el cual llenaras en el apartado de tu tienda, con la información que te solicita dicho formato.


- Pocca. 


Enseguida de estos formatos, ingresaras a la pagina de intranet de POCCA con tu usuario y contraseña y en la parte superior izquierda seleccionaras la opción clientes, esto desplegara una pantalla donde te aparecerá una opción de buscar clientes, en ella ingresas el nombre de tu cliente, si este ya esta registrado te aparecerá y puedes pasar al siguiente punto de generar el proyecto, de no ser así, deberás ingresar al cliente primero.


 Ingresar al cliente. 


Una vez que el buscador no arrojo ningún resultado, seleccionaras la opción crear nuevo, y desplegara un formato que deberás llenar con los datos recabados de tu cliente en el formato de ventas. Una vez ingresados los datos, en la parte inferior seleccionaras “Enviar a autorización” y esperaras a que sea autorizado.


 Ingresar el proyecto. 


Una vez que ingresaste a tu cliente y fue autorizado, volverás a POCCA a ingresar el proyecto.

En la parte superior izquierda, seleccionaras la opción proyecto y en la siguiente pantalla seleccionaras la opción Crear nuevo.

Te pedirá crear un nombre, este deberá contener los datos de tu venta siguiendo el ejemplo que te pongo a continuación:

JUAN PEREZ SANCHEZ. 1 AERON B GRAFITO VINIL. 20% BUEN FIN. PHGUADALAJARA. STK

Enseguida abrirá otro formato que deberás llenar con los datos que te pide. En el apartado de facturación seleccionaras el nombre de RAFAEL ARZOZ GUTIERREZ.

Y en la sección Monto del proyecto te solicitara tres valores, estos los conseguirás en tu PDF que generaras en otro programa denominado “2020 Worksheet”.

Una vez ingresado todo lo mandaras a autorización.


 Ingresar la orden. 


Por ultimo en POCCA, una vez te autorizaron el proyecto, deberás ingresar la orden, para ello debes ingresar a tu proyecto autorizado, y en la parte superior veras un icono con la leyenda “Crear Orden”, seleccionamos ese icono, y nos desplegara una primera pantalla en la que ingresaremos el nombre de la orden, el cual puede ser el mismo que se utilizó para el proyecto.

Después de ello te abrirá otro formulario en el que llenaras los datos que te pide, ingresaras tu SIF y PDF de 2020 y al igual que el proyecto, mandaras a autorización.


- 2020 Worksheet. 


En este programa crearas tu pedido. Ingresaras con el usuario y contraseña que se te asignen, abrirás una hoja en blanco una vez dentro, y el catálogo en otra, después en el catalogo buscaras el articulo que vendiste, lo copiaras y lo pegaras en tu hoja en blanco.

Una vez que tengas tu pieza, te vas a la opción “Apply Schedule” y seleccionaras el código asignado para ese mes en curso. Después de ello colocaras el margen que te arrojo tu venta, el cual puedes calcular con una tabla de Excel. Y por último colocaras STK o HMI según sea el caso en la casilla correspondiente. Cuando tengas todo esto vas a la opción de Export SIF con la que crearas el SIF para tu orden, y después en la opción de crear informe seleccionaras “Estándar Finance”, con la que crearas tu PDF para tu orden.


- DASS. 


Cuando ya tienes tu proyecto en POCCA autorizado, así como tu orden autorizada, deberás ingresar a DASS para subir dicho proyecto y que sea programado para entrega.

El link lo encontraras también en tu correo, al abrirlo desplegara un formulario con datos del proyecto los cuales debes ingresar siempre y cuando este autorizado y sea una pieza con la que se cuenta en stock, al ingresarlos también deberás señalar la fecha de entrega no menor a 48 horas después del día en que lo ingresas en CDMX, o si fuera para Mty o Guadalajara seleccionaras “waiting for someone else”.

Deberás acordar con tu cliente el día de entrega para que al momento de que lo visiten pueda recibir.

¿Como realizar un cambio?

Si tu cliente después de algunos días, en los que tu ya tienes tu proyecto y tu orden autorizados o en espera de autorización únicamente, te pide hacer un cambio, deberás primero:


 En Palacio de Hierro cobraras la diferencia, haciendo una devolución y después generando un nuevo ticket con el total de la nueva compra, para que el cobro no quede separado en dos tickets (compra inicial + diferencia) si no que sea un solo ticket con el total de la nueva pieza. 
 Pedirás el formato de Excel de cambio de montos el cual deberás llenar con la información que te solicita dicho formato (montos anteriores, nuevos montos, diferencia). 
 En 2020 deberás generar tu nuevo SIF y PDF para que con ello ingreses la información del Excel de cambio de montos. 
 En POCCA ingresa a tu orden, selecciona cancelar orden, y ingresa las opciones que te solicita para después seleccionar solicitar autorización, para que esa cancelación de orden te sea autorizada. 
 Mandaras un correo a Alberto Medina pidiéndole que te desautorice el proyecto para modificar los montos del proyecto inicial y así poder ingresar los nuevos montos, en este correo adjuntaras el formato de Excel de cambio de montos que llenaste anteriormente y se lo enviaras una vez tengas cancelada tu orden. El proyecto no se puede cancelar solo desautorizar. 
 Una vez desautorizado, modificaras los montos por los de tu nuevo proyecto, indicados en tu nuevo SIF, y volverás a mandar a autorización el proyecto indicando en Observaciones que fue un cambio de montos por cambio de articulo a solicitud del cliente. 
 Después de que el proyecto sea autorizado vas a crear una nueva orden con los nuevos montos y a la cual le vas a cargar tu nuevo SIF y PDF. Una vez hecho esto los demás pasos siguen como en una venta normal. 


¿Cómo realizar una devolución?

Deberás mandar un correo a Alberto Medina y a Cony en el que expliques el motivo de la devolución con copia a Esperanza, adjuntando el ticket de cobro de Palacio de Hierro y el formato de venta, después de ello, esperaras una respuesta en la que se te dirá si se autoriza o no dicha devolución.

Una vez autorizado, únicamente cancelaras la orden en POCCA, ya que el proyecto no se puede cancelar.

En Palacio de Hierro pedirás también autorización al jefe de piso, te preguntara que, si la marca ya te lo autorizo, y una vez autorizado también por él, pedirás a un vendedor que lleve a cabo la devolución a tu cliente.

Una vez realizada, pídele al vendedor una copia del comprobante antes de darlo al cliente, y esa copia escanéala y mándala a Alberto y a Cony en otro correo.

En el formato de Stock de Excel debes cambiar el status de la venta a cancelado.

Who We Hire?

Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. HermanMiller is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.

MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers_help@millerknoll.com.
