description:
About the job

As a Team Lead, Account Manager at Equativ, you’ll play a pivotal role in delivering best-in-class service to our clients while ensuring seamless execution of campaigns. Sitting at the intersection of client relationships, campaign management, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Operations to maximize client satisfaction and business growth. This is an opportunity to work hands-on at the front lines of digital advertising, supporting both direct and programmatic campaigns for some of the industry’s most innovative partners.

What You’ll Do:
Team Leadership & Development


Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 4 Account Managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
Conduct regular one-on-ones and coaching sessions to support career development and team success
Conduct a weekly AM meeting to discuss wins, challenges, process improvements, 
Oversee workload distribution, resource planning, and prioritization to ensure consistent service levels across the team
Champion operational excellence by identifying process improvements, documenting best practices, and driving adoption across the organization
Partner with leadership on hiring, onboarding, training, and succession planning




Campaign & Client Relationship Management


Act as the primary day-to-day contact for your book of business, building long-term partnerships rooted in trust, transparency, and performance
Represent Equativ in client-facing activities, including campaign updates, business reviews, and occasional client entertainment
Oversee end-to-end execution of direct and programmatic campaigns, ensuring deadlines, budgets, materials, and performance metrics are met
Serve as the main liaison between clients and the Ad Ops/Traffic teams to resolve issues and maintain seamless communication




Strategic Planning & Performance


Analyze account performance and client feedback to identify optimization opportunities and strategic recommendations
Track and report on key team KPIs, including client satisfaction, campaign delivery, retention, and operational efficiency
Contribute to quarterly business planning, forecasting, and revenue growth initiatives alongside Sales leadership
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, client outcomes, and team productivity




Who You Are:


5+ years in account management or client services in digital advertising, ad tech, or media, including experience managing or mentoring a team
Strong leadership and coaching skills with a passion for developing high-performing teams
Excellent communicator who builds trusted relationships with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners
Deep understanding of direct and programmatic advertising, campaign execution, and account management best practices
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strategic thinker who balances client advocacy with operational excellence and business objectives
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and driving change
 Fluent in Spanish and English (required)




Nice to Have:


 Experience with Salesforce, DV360, SSPs/DSPs, or publisher monetization platforms
 Existing relationships with media agencies and/or direct advertisers in Mexico or LATAM
 Portuguese language skills (a plus for accounts spanning Brazil)
 Familiarity with the CTV/streaming advertising landscape in Latin America




👋 About us

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.

Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.

With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.

The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.

As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.

Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

Equativ is an equal opportunity employer. Equal access to employment, services, and programs are available to everyone, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require reasonable accommodation throughout the application and/or interview process, please contact the recruitment team at ta-team@equativ.com

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Customer Catalog Coordinator

Strong catalog, data, process, or operational coordination skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to organize complex requirements, identify gaps or dependencies, and maintain controlled records through completion.
Strong planning, prioritization, communication, meeting facilitation, reporting, and stakeholder follow-up skills.
Ability to work across transition, service delivery, sales, product, procurement, ordering, configuration, partner, and customer teams.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and other Microsoft 365 applications.
Experience with ticketing or service-management tools, preferably ServiceNow.
Ability to interpret operational requirements and contract commitments and translate them into documented catalog activities.
Ability to work independently in a virtual, cross-functional, and global environment.
Fluent written and spoken English.
1-3 years of experience in catalog management, product or service data administration, customer onboarding, project coordination, service coordination, order management, or a related environment.
Experience maintaining customer, product, or service catalogs and supporting catalog governance or change control.
Experience supporting DaaS, Managed Services, IT services, device lifecycle services, or customer onboarding.

Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Customer catalogs are accurate, complete, current, controlled, and ready for onboarding and ongoing operations.
Requirements, approvals, testing, changes, and handover activities are completed and documented on schedule.
Catalog actions, risks, issues, and dependencies are progressed to closure.

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager
skills: Serve as the primary technical advisor and point of coordination for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers
Build and maintain trusted relationships with practitioners, technical leaders, managers, directors, and C-level executives
Translate complex business objectives into actionable technical strategies, success plans, and operational priorities
Proactively identify customer needs, technical risks, and opportunities for optimization, adoption, and long-term improvement
Orchestrate the resolution of complex technical issues by coordinating across Adobe Engineering, TechOps, Managed Services, Support, Product, and other internal teams
Establish clear expectations and maintain consistent communication through regular checkpoints, status reviews, governance meetings, and planning sessions.
Conduct in-depth assessments of customers’ technical environments to identify architectural risks, performance concerns, integration challenges, and opportunities for improvement
Provide strategic advice on implementation approaches, technical guidelines, scalability, performance, integrations, and operational readiness
Co-lead Quarterly Business Reviews, executive briefings, and technical presentations, connecting the realities of the customer’s technical environment with business priorities and measurable outcomes
Maintain structured oversight of open actions, technical dependencies, risks, and critical issues, ensuring clear ownership and timely follow-through
Advocate for customers within Adobe while balancing their priorities with technical feasibility, product capabilities, and internal commitments
Collaborate across Adobe teams to deliver a coordinated and consistent customer experience
Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
Seven or more years of experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, solution architecture, or another senior customer-facing technical role
Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customer relationships in a consultative capacity
Good understanding of marketing technology, advertising technology, and AI-powered solutions, including their application within complex enterprise environments
Strong knowledge of web technologies, including JavaScript, jQuery, Java, HTML/HTML5, CSS, REST APIs, and database technologies
Solid understanding of tag management, digital data collection, and enterprise implementation methodologies
Experience solving issues, performance-tuning, and optimizing web/app environments
Ability to read and interpret code, fix technical implementations, and understand third-party integrations at the API level

title: Representante de Tienda HILTI- Guadalajara
description:
About the job

¡Mejora la Industria de la Construcción desde Guadalajara!

Buscamos un/a Representante de Hilti Store, para ser responsable por nuestra tienda Hilti en Guadalajara, esta posición es responsable de atender clientes diariamente, gestionar procesos administrativos del día a día, ingresar pedidos, recibir mercancías y/o herramientas a reparar, manejar inventario y efectivo para lo cual buscamos un profesional responsable, planificado y orientado a soluciones.

Recibirás a diferentes clientes de la industria de la construcción, sub contratistas, Industrias, usuarios, con diferentes proyectos, operaciones y necesidades a los cuales podrás conocer para proponer soluciones a la medida.

¡Se parte de una de nuestras Hilti Stores en un mercado en crecimiento!

Lo que harás

Tus Responsabilidades Estarán Centradas En Dar Atención Directa Al Público, Atendiendo Los Requerimientos De Los Clientes Que Visitan La Tienda Realizando

Demostraciones de los productos HILTI en la tienda.

Alta de pedidos dentro del sistema

Gestionar los procesos de facturación y venta dentro de tienda

Recepción herramientas en proceso de reparación

Manejo de inventario

Interacción con los clientes en piso de ventas para identificar las necesidades y acompañar en el proceso de venta

Responsable de la tienda y los procesos administrativos para su correcto funcionamiento.

Lo que aportarás

Al menos 1 o 2 años de experiencia en roles con contacto directo con el cliente en diversas industrias, preferible en la industria de la construcción.

Graduado/a universitario de carreras de Ingeniería, Administración, comerciales o afines.

Habilidades o potencial de relacionamiento comercial

Autonomía y organización

Habilidades de trabajo en equipo y colaboración.

Experiencia o adaptabilidad a plataformas como SAP, CRMs y herramientas de office.

Curiosidad, capacidad de aprendizaje constante.

Lo que te ofrecemos

Contrato indeterminado con nuestra compañía (Hilti Mexicana)

Salario competitivo

Bono variable mensual según resultados de venta

Beneficios de ley

Seguro de gastos medicos mayores, menores y dentales

Beneficios adicionales

En Hilti tendrás capacitación y soporte para desarrollar tu trabajo, buscamos un perfil con curiosidad, proactividad y criterio que pueda crecer en nuestra compañía.

Por qué Hilti

Hilti es un líder mundial en innovación para la construcción, con más de 34 000 personas en 120 países. Guiados por nuestro propósito, Making Construction Better (Mejorar la industria de la construcción), nos impulsa seguir aprendiendo, creciendo y descubriendo nuevas maneras de generar un impacto duradero. Aquí encontrará los medios para aprovechar sus fortalezas, trabajar en un equipo global e inclusivo, y asumir grandes desafíos. En Hilti, tendrá la oportunidad de que sus ideas, logros y crecimiento se hagan realidad por medio del propósito, la pasión y el trabajo en equipo.

Compromiso con la inclusión

En Hilti, la inclusión es un factor clave de cómo trabajamos, lideramos y crecemos juntos. Tenemos el compromiso de abrazar la diversidad de pensamiento y generar un entorno que sea inclusivo para todos, en todas partes. Buscamos en todo momento asegurar que la voz de cada uno sea valorada y de que cada miembro del equipo se sienta empoderado para contribuir. A partir de estos cimientos, los equipos, la innovación y los logros se fortalecen, para que podamos mejorar la construcción juntos.
